title: SkillAcceptanceRun
description: Results record for one acceptance test run of a robot skill or VLA model against a specific embodiment. Used by the Robot Skill Acceptance Lab (RESET XIX, 2026-08-20).

runId.description: Unique identifier for this acceptance run.

skillId.description: Identifier of the robot skill or VLA model being tested.

skillVersion.description: Version string of the skill, e.g. '3.2.1'.

skillProvider.description: Organisation that produced or distributes the skill.

embodimentId.description: Reference to the EmbodimentDescriptor.embodimentId used in this run.

taskDescription.description: Natural language description of the task tested, e.g. 'Adaptive depalletize irregular cardboard boxes'.

trialCount.description: Total number of physical trial cycles executed.

completionRate.description: Fraction of trials completed successfully without any intervention. 1.0 = 100%.

unassistedRecoveryRate.description: Fraction of failures the skill recovered from autonomously.

humanInterventionRate.description: Fraction of trials requiring human intervention.

medianCycleTimeSec.description: Median cycle time across all completed trials in seconds.

requiredSLOSec.description: Maximum cycle time required by the customer's SLO in seconds.

sloMet.description: Whether the p95 cycle time satisfies the required SLO.

payloadTestedKg.description: Actual payload weight tested in kilograms.

scenarioResults.description: Results for named test scenarios, e.g. dark-carton, reflective-tape, max-payload.

safetyEnvelopePass.description: Whether the skill stayed within defined safety envelopes throughout all trials.

safetyViolations.description: Number of safety envelope violations observed.

productionAcceptance.description: Overall acceptance verdict for production deployment.

conditionalRequirements.description: Conditions that must be met before full acceptance (if CONDITIONAL).

simulatorCorrelation.description: Pearson correlation between simulator-predicted and observed completion rate, if available.

baselineSimulatorScore.description: The skill provider's reported simulator success rate for comparison.

conductedBy.description: Organisation or individual who conducted the acceptance test.

runDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the physical acceptance run was conducted.

reportUrl.description: URL to the full acceptance report if published.
